intentEvidence: designed to make it extremely easy to capture and store your valuable online resources in a structured and meaningful way.
motivation: To easily store useful links that integrate well with the author's existing workflow and make it easy to query and organize later.
problem: Difficulty capturing and organizing valuable online resources and bookmarks within a structured note-taking system.

relations.evidence: You can also use the Dataview plugin to query your links.

summary: A plugin that sync links saved via a Chrome Extension into the Obsidian vault, allowing structured storage and organization.
